title: Steel and Flint
description: Adds Steel that must be used to craft Flint and Steel, for your inconvenience.
body:
**Steel and Flint** puts the Steel into Flint and Steel:            
Adds a "Steel" item which replaces Iron in the crafting recipe for Flint and Steel.         
Steel is made by smelting Iron.

--------------------------------------------

<details>
<summary>Steel and Flint boasts a plethora of fresh and exciting content:</summary>

- **1** item
- **1** Flint and Steel recipe
- **2** Steel recipes

</details>
